The OL361 A3 Mini Laminating Machine is a compact and powerful laminating machine that not only meets the need for document protection in daily office work, but it's exquisite appearance and convenient operation also provide unlimited possibilities for creative output. It uses advanced sensor technology and intelligent control systems to identify and adjust paper size and achieve one-click lamination. OL361   A3 Mini Laminating Machine also performs well in lamination effects. It supports a variety of lamination materials, such as matte film, glossy film, frosted film, etc. Users can flexibly choose lamination according to document type and style requirements. Product introduction

OL261 80 Micron   Hot Kraft Paper A4 Laminating Machine is a hot laminating machine designed for A4 size paper, using 75 micron thick hot laminating material. It is suitable for all kinds of documents, pictures, posters, etc. that need to be protected. The laminating material is firmly bonded to the surface of the paper through hot pressing technology to achieve waterproof, anti-fouling, wear-resistant, and glossy effects.
After the machine is started, the heating roller begins to heat up to the set working temperature (usually between 100℃ and 180℃, depending on the melting point of the laminating material and the type of paper). The A4 paper to be laminated is fed into the machine through the paper feeding system, and the hot laminating material is also ally pulled and covered on the surface of the paper. Under the joint action of the heating roller and the pressure roller, the paper and the laminating material are treated with high temperature and high pressure, so that the laminating material is melted and firmly bonded to the paper. The paper after hot pressing is quickly cooled and shaped through the cooling system, and finally, ally discharged from the paper outlet to complete the laminating process.
